verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no full-data export feature, no open export formats, and nothing about offboarding. The only related items are a `sf data query` CLI command and a generic API pointer. These are developer building blocks for querying data, not a documented export-everything-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
